title: Allen Taylor & Company Ltd (a subsidiary of Boral Timber) - proposed acquisition of J & JL Davis Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Allen Taylor & Company Ltd (a Boral subsidiary) proposed to acquire J & JL Davis Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The Commission did not need to conclusively define the market to reach a view on this issue.  The most relevant market is one (defined narrowly) for green-sawn hardwood timber products in south-eastern Australia.  The market (defined narrowly) for hardwood timber flooring in eastern mainland Australia was also considered.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The proposed acquisition is unlikely to result in the Commission's concentration thresholds being crossed in either market.
